item.text: I found the two causes: saving a completion overwrites the per-size value without comparing it, and the status display substitutes `0` when no value exists. I’m checking the project’s source conventions and related status fixtures before editing those paths.

item.text:
Fixed both score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts): a completed game only replaces that size’s best when it uses fewer moves; equal or worse scores leave preferences unchanged.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx): an unset best now displays “none” instead of `0`, using the label in [status-labels.ts](/work/src/game/status/status-labels.ts).

I didn’t run tests.
